concept:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a landscape concept sheet for this exact anime sewing racing game. Use the attached gameplay screenshot as the identity and layout reference, keep flat palms, purple headband character, small central metal presser foot, vertical needle, stitched parchment HUD and purple seam corridor. Replace flat drift scratch marks with physically raised gathered FABRIC FOLDS. Main top 75%: full gameplay camera, a right-hand drift presses fabric laterally, 3-4 low rounded asymmetric purple cloth ridges bunch up beside the seam near the presser foot and sweep into the near foreground, like a tablecloth being pushed sideways by a flat palm. Fold crests lift visibly above the cloth plane with broad lit shoulders, dark narrow troughs and attached contact shadows. Continuous same woven cloth, not detached strips, rock, liquid, tire rubber, smoke, tears or holes. Keep clear central red stitch line and small presser foot; folds stay below hands, do not obscure HUD. No penalty speech bubble. Maintain hand aspect ratio.
Bottom 25% clean cream design strip with three closeup panels illustrating smooth fabric, gathered raised folds under lateral pressure, and relaxing shallow creases. Labels only "01 FLAT", "02 GATHER", "03 RELAX". Include a small schematic cross section of a low wave under each closeup to emphasize real vertical lift instead of a painted skid. Artistic anime game shading and textile weave. No extra characters, no dramatic mountains.
height: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game VFX HEIGHT MAP, square 1024x1024 opaque grayscale PNG. This is numeric displacement art, NOT a lit illustration. Orthographic top-down height field of three gently curved elongated gathered cloth ridges, aligned generally vertically in the square with asymmetric softly tapered tips. Imagine a flat fabric sheet being pushed sideways, buckling into three neighboring soft parallel folds. One dominant broad central ridge and two slightly lower shorter ridges at left and right. White means highest elevation, black means zero elevation, grayscale slopes smooth rounded continuous transitions. Peak grayscale about 230/255, shoulders continuous medium gray fading into black. All ridges taper to exact black before reaching the image edges; leave an outer margin of at least 12% exact pure black on ALL four edges. No lighting or cast shadows, no fabric weave or texture, no hard outlines, no perspective, no 3D beauty rendering, no checkerboard, no alpha transparency, no lettering, no border. Smooth low frequency shapes without noise or small wrinkles. Black troughs separate the three ridge masses. Ready for sampling as linear data by a displacement shader or mesh.
